name: AI Agents Get Their Own Accounts
tagline: 54 things to know about Google's universal Gemini agent, which gets its own email, calendar and Drive, and the race for always-on AI coworkers.
description: A 54-card ScrollAI Daily snapshot on 9 October 2026 covering Google Cloud's persistent Gemini agents, their memory, identity and controls, rival agents from Microsoft and OpenAI, and the agent security findings from Pwn2Own Ireland.
